  • Airstrikes & Counterstrikes
    • US/Israeli strikes on Iranian targets continue intermittently. Iran-backed groups continue missile/rocket counterstrikes on Israel.

    • Temporary pause in energy strikes and active Pakistani mediation create a short window for de-escalation.

Situation Brief — Day 27 (last 6h)

  • Pause & Diplomacy: Trump announced a second 10-day pause on strikes targeting Iran’s energy sector (deadline Apr 6, 2026 20:00 ET). US says talks “going very well.” Iran denies direct talks. Pakistan is mediating. Tactical context: the first 5-day pause (Mar 23) was violated hours later by US/Israeli strikes on Isfahan and Khorramshahr — pauses remain fragile.
  • Airspace & Travel: Civil airspace largely closed across the region. Flight scans show ~346–352 aircraft; airports closed in Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan. Expect continued cancellations and supply/evacuation delays.
  • Northern Border: Hezbollah active daily. Reports of growing Lebanese public discontent but no verified new large-scale strikes in last 6 hours. Tactical: Hezbollah continues rocket/drone harassment patterns.
  • Iran internal: Supreme Leader Khamenei laid in state; week-long funeral events underway. High-risk window for sympathetic retaliatory attacks and security incidents.
  • International & military moves: Iran allows Strait of Hormuz passage for Russia, India, China while blocking others. Russia warns it will repel threats to the Union State. Reports the US will waive some long-standing oil sanctions — may shift economic dynamics.
  • Counter‑UAS & weapons: Russian firms advertise anti‑drone rounds and mobile jammers. Expect faster regional deployment of counter‑drone tech.
  • Security ops & intel: IDF/Shin Bet say they killed a Hamas operative who held four hostages. Media reports US warned Iran about Israeli plans to target Iranian negotiators; other outlets claim Israeli plots — increases diplomatic strain.
  • Impact: Transport disruptions, continued high alert along borders and airspace. Civilian travel should remain suspended.
  • 🟢 Good News: 10-day pause announced; IDF action removed a hostage-taker; reported US sanction waivers could ease economic pressure.
  • Threat assessment: Volatile — pauses are fragile; risk of renewed strikes remains.

  • Northern Border (Lebanon/Hezbollah): Daily Hezbollah activity. Regular missile/rocket exchanges and cross-border fire continue. Tension remains high with sustained harassment-level attacks.

  • Strait of Hormuz: Iran allows passage selectively — friendly states (Russia, India, China) cleared; others blocked or restricted. Shipping routes and insurance costs remain disrupted.
  • Airspace & civilian impact: Major regional airports reported closed (Iran, Israel, Iraq, Syria, Lebanon, Jordan). Commercial flight reductions and airspace restrictions persist.
  • International moves: Pakistan actively mediating. Reports of US waiving some Iran oil sanctions appear in circulation. No major troop deployments reported in last 48h.
  • Other operations: Israel continues targeted ground/intel actions (arrests, counterterror operations) against Hamas-linked cells.
  • 🟢 Good News: Second pause on energy strikes offers a 10-day diplomatic window. IDF/partner actions reported successful against specific terror leaders.
  • Threat assessment: Escalating — pauses fragile; strikes continue on both sides.
